recipes.name: Hearty Chicken and Noodle Casserole
ingredients_raw: 2 cups medium egg noodles, cooked and drained
1 (10.75 ounce) can Campbell's® Condensed Cream of Mushroom Soup (Regular, 98% Fat Free or 25% Less Sodium)

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C).
Combine chicken, noodles, soup, vegetables, milk, Parmesan cheese, and black pepper in a 1 ½-quart casserole dish.
Bake in the preheated oven until hot, about 25 minutes. Stir; top with Cheddar cheese.

raw_recipe.headline: Hearty Chicken and Noodle Casserole
raw_recipe.description: This hearty chicken and noodle casserole recipe features tender chicken, mixed vegetables, noodles, condensed cream of mushroom soup, and lots of cheese.

review.reviewBody: I loved this recipe, it was simple to make and my husband loved it. Just make sure to use a mild cheddar, sharp overpowers the flavor of the cream of mushroom soup!

I made this for my mom & my boyfriend. I used 3 cups of egg noodles. I cooked the chicken breast in the oven on a cookie sheet for 35 mins, seasoned with onion & garlic powder, parsley, light salt, pepper, poultry seasoning & paprika. I flipped the breasts halfway through. Then I added 1/2 cup of sour cream, instead of milk, & used a 1/4 cup of milk to make it creamier & not dry out while baking. I seasoned the sauce with garlic & onion powder, salt & pepper & parsley. I know I altered the recipe but I read so many reviews & having made it before with the exact directions I knew it would be bland with just pepper. Also half of the casserole was topped with breadcrumbs & medium cheddar cheese, the other with crushed fried onions (as a taste test). Both are equally good depending on what you're in the mood for. adding extra noodles, chicken & veggies helped too since my boyfriend are 3 helpings! I will be adding this to my dinner menu!! the main recipe is a good base but I found the it needed more seasoning. It's a great starting out point. play around with it & have fun. It's really good!! ??

I made several adjustments: I used Cream of Chicken soup and added a cup of sliced mushrooms to the frozen veggies, which I sauteed in a tbs of butter before adding to the noodle/soup/chicken mixture. I also added 1 tbs. of Dash Garlic and Herb seasoning blend because people said the casserole was a little bland. And, I used parmesan cheese in the casserole (instead of cheddar) which I think tastes better with mushrooms. After 30 min in the oven, I sprinkled the other 1/2 cup of parmesan on top, and baked 10 minutes more until the cheese was melted. We liked it a lot!

I made this using 1 can cream of chicken soup, & 1 can cream of mushroom soup. For the topping, I melted butter and added breadcrumbs then sprinkled that on top. I have celiac so I have to be gluten free. I doubled the recipe. This was very easy to make especially with gluten free products!

Chicken noodle casserole came out good. I doubled the recipe. For flavor just add 1 teaspoon each of salt, garlic powder, onion powder, dried oregano, dried basil, dried parsley, and 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme. Cover the casserole with aluminum foil before popping it in the oven.

I sautéed the onion, celery and frozen vegetables for about 5 to 6 minutes in butter in small skillet. Added to rest of the ingredients. Added a 1/2 tsp of garlic powder salt and pepper. Baked for 30 minutes. Very flavorful! I cooked 2 chicken quarters with Knorrs Caldo de Pollo. Once done, I boiled the noodles in the chicken broth.

I found this to be a wonderful recipe,like others though I made some minor changes, instead of the 1/2 cup of milk I used a can of evaporated milk as I find it makes the casserole have a creamier texture.Like most of my main meals I do like to add a small amount of garlic powder. I also increased the amount of cheddar cheese from 1/2 to 3/4cup and added it to the top of of the casserole 15 min in so it had a chance to melt and seal in the moisture. The only criticism I would have is the baking time is too short to properly soften the frozen vegetables.
We liked it. I added 1/4 sauteed-in-butter chopped onions and 1/2 cup rehydrated mixed dried mushrooms. Very good and extended the meals I can get out of a rotisserie chicken. Yay.

Instead of using all frozen veggies I large diced fresh carrots, celery and onion and sauteed them for a few minutes in butter. I had small amounts of frozen corn and frozen peas that I added to the pan for a moment too. I used about half a bag of wide egg noodles. After assembling I put a layer of grated cheddar cheese over the top before baking, and as I put servings on plates I sprinkled them with French's Crispy Fried Onions. Sounds like a lot of changes to the original recipe but is basically the same and I think the original prep. method is probably really good too. My family all enjoyed it and dubbed it a "great comfort food!"

This was pretty yummy but I made some modifications because I did not have the exact ingredients. I used left over cooked broccoli, zucchini, peas & corn instead of frozen veggies. I also sauteed about 1/2 c chopped onion with 1/2 t minced garlic and mixed that in. I cut the cheddar cheese in half & mixed it into the casserole then lightly sprinkled Italian breadcrumbs on top. Would make this again. Quick, easy & yummy.
I used broccoli,corn, and a few sliced carrots and added a half cup more milk because it seemed dry. I also added buttered bread crumbs with cheddar at the end.
Such an easy recipe to make! Definitely a keeper!!
A little more salt might be good.
It’s a little bland but tasty nonetheless! I also switched the cream of mushroom for cream of chicken because my husband is allergic to mushrooms. I would totally make this again!
It was delicious. Very flavorful and very hearty. It's very easy to make and I'm surprised how good it tasted.
A bit bland. Made the Golden Onion version.
We love this recipe, the kids will gobble it up & that’s saying something!
I used sliced fresh carrots and cream of mushroom with garlic. It was super yummy!
Made this casserole exactly the way the recipe said to and it came out great I took it to a church social and everybody loved it I will be making us again
